brief_rationale: The doctor systematically corrected the family's misconception that tumor marker elevation equals cancer, actively discovered the hidden medication history (MTX stopped, tocilizumab used), verified ambiguous record fragments (SpO2 20%), and dynamically prioritized outpatient vs. emergency based on evolving symptoms. No responsibility-chain error was identified; all six RCs are met. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, while HO3 was partially completed. This satisfies Strong boundary (≥1 HO completed) but does not reach Perfect because only one HO was fully completed with independent non-overlapping evidence.
